prompt:
Create a crisp pixel-art speech-mouth atlas for the exact NPC073 face in a restrained SAD expression. Use the supplied single 3×3 reference grid as the identity, original lip scale and center, jaw, nose, blue wand, neck, hair, background registration, palette, and native-pixel guide.

Canvas: exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, with every cell the same complete lower-half crop of 64×29 native pixels; overall aspect ratio 64:29. No labels, gutters, borders, margins, text, or extra panels. Row-major cells are A B C / D E F / G H X.

Use these actual Rhubarb mouth-shape definitions exactly:
A: Closed lips with light pressure for P, B, M.
B: Slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening for most consonants and EE.
C: Medium open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips for EH and AE.
D: Wide vertical opening for an open vowel AA; larger than C.
E: Slightly rounded lips with an opening no wider than C for AO and ER.
F: Puckered rounded lips with a small forward opening for UW, OW, W; not a tooth bite.
G: Upper teeth touch lower lip for F and V; not a wide open vowel.
H: Tongue raised behind upper teeth for long L, with an opening between C and D; tongue may be small or invisible at native scale.
X: Relaxed closed idle lips.

Keep the SAD mood restrained and consistent across poses: subtly lowered corners and soft lip tension, not a severe frown or complete smile. Preserve the source small muted pink/terracotta lips and exact mouth center, jaw, nose, chin, neck, hair, blue wand, and lower-half registration. Where teeth are visible, use muted neutral ivory/gray clearly distinct from skin, with modest mouth-cavity contrast. Do not use lipstick-red lips, warm skin-colored teeth, tooth gaps, bright white shiny teeth, excessive dark cavity, exaggerated corners, or a large surrounding skin repaint. Keep every phoneme pose recognizable. Crisp stepped native pixel clusters; no blur, smoothing, antialiasing, resampling, or vector shapes.
